usageNotes: Sends a raw QEMU monitor command to a running VM; the VM must be in a running state on the specified node or the command will fail. Read-only introspection commands (info, ?, help) require only Sys.Audit, while most state-changing commands require Sys.Modify, and a subset of device/migration/dump commands are root-only. The response is a plain string containing the monitor output, not a task UPID — execution is synchronous.

examples.summary: Query memory balloon target on VM 105

tips: Send 'info status' to quickly check whether a VM is running, paused, or shutdown without fetching the full VM config.
Use 'system_powerdown' (requires Sys.Modify) to trigger a graceful ACPI shutdown; prefer this over a hard stop when the guest OS responds to ACPI events.
Root-only commands (device_add, migrate, screendump, etc.) will be rejected for API token users even with full privileges — they require a root@pam session.
Commands marked deprecated in the permissions description (stopcapture, wavcapture) may be removed in future QEMU versions; avoid relying on them.
The monitor interface is stateless per request; multi-step QEMU monitor workflows (e.g. savevm then loadvm) must be issued as separate API calls.
